Jamie 


1) Controller / Processor
- Redwood confirms we will act as Processor for all Catalyst customer data processed via our hosted offering. We will sign a DPA with explicit Processor statements and standard data processing schedules.

2) Subprocessors
- Attached: Redwood_subprocessors_list.pdf (current as of 2027-07-02). We provide 30 days' notice for new subprocessors. For this engagement we can review any named opt-out requests 

3) Breach notification
- Redwood's standard timeline is initial notification within 72 hours of confirmed discovery. We understand Catalyst's ask for 48 hours; at present we cannot commit to 48 hours across all incident classes but will prioritize your tenant and provide an escalation path. We can include an SLA escalation clause in the DPA for critical incidents. Rishi will propose exact wording.

4) Data residency
- We can guarantee US-only residency for your production tenant and backups in our US regions. Any DR replicas will remain in US regions only; this will be specified in the deployment schedule and tenant configuration.

5) Retention & deletion
- Default retention for request/embedding caches is 180 days. For Catalyst we can offer a contractual retention of 90 days with an on-demand purge capability at termination or on written request. Marissa: please advise on the operational steps to execute a purge and expected SLAs.

6) PII handling
- Redwood supports field-level filtering and offers a pseudonymization pipeline for sensitive fields prior to embedding. We also have guidance for prompt engineering to avoid sending raw PII. We'll include recommended configuration snippets in the DPA appendix.

7) Audit / logging controls
- We can provide quarterly exports of request-level audit logs and token-level metadata. For customers on Dedicated plans we offer direct log access; for Hosted we provide encrypted export deliveries. We'll include an export schedule in the SOW.

Attachments: Redwood_subprocessors_list.pdf, DPA_response_summary.pdf (short doc mapping Catalyst asks to Redwood positions).

Next steps:
- Rishi to draft opt-out/subprocessor language and breach-notice wording (ETA: 7/5).
- Marissa to confirm purge runbook and export cadence (ETA: 7/5).
- Offer: short legal sync 7/6 at 10am ET (30 min) to finalize DPA redlines; please confirm availability.

If you prefer we can also circulate a redline directly in DocuSign once legal items are agreed.

Thanks again
